source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the preparation of carboxylic acids (PDF 108-110).

items: Primary alcohols aur aldehydes ki oxidation: shuruati maadde ko zaid tezaabi KMnO4 ya K2Cr2O7 ke saath reflux par garam kiya jata hai: CH3CH2OH + 2[O] -> CH3COOH + H2O; CH3CHO + [O] -> CH3COOH.

Nitriles ki hydrolysis: tezaab mein nitriles seedhe carboxylic acids dete hain, CH3CN + 2H2O + HCl -> CH3COOH + NH4Cl; alkali mein pehle namak dete hain, CH3CN + H2O + NaOH -> CH3COONa + NH3, jo tezaab milane par tezaab deta hai, CH3COONa + HCl -> CH3COOH + NaCl.

Esters ki hydrolysis: halke tezaab ke saath reflux se tezaab aur alcohol bante hain, CH3COOCH2CH3 + H2O <=> CH3COOH + CH3CH2OH (H3O+); halki alkali se carboxylate namak banta, CH3COOCH2CH3 + NaOH -> CH3COONa + CH3CH2OH, aur tezaab milane se tezaab milta hai.
Benzoic acid (benzenecarboxylic acid): methylbenzene tezaabi KMnO4 ya K2Cr2O7 se aasani se oxidise hota hai: C6H5CH3 + 3[O] -> C6H5COOH + H2O (KMnO4, halka H2SO4, garmi).

blocks.alt: Chaar dabbe jin se R-COOH tak teer: oxidation, CH3CH2OH + 2[O] -> CH3COOH + H2O, K2Cr2O7/halke H2SO4 ke saath reflux; nitrile hydrolysis, CH3CN + 2H2O + HCl -> CH3COOH + NH4Cl, ya NaOH phir tezaab; ester hydrolysis, CH3COOC2H5 + H2O <=> CH3COOH + C2H5OH; side-chain oxidation, C6H5CH3 + 3[O] -> C6H5COOH + H2O KMnO4 ke saath.
blocks.caption: Carboxylic acids banane ke chaar tareeqe (kitab ke tareeqon ka asal khulasa).
blocks.long_description: Carboxylic acids oxidation (primary alcohols, aldehydes ya alkylbenzene ki side chain ki) ya hydrolysis (nitriles ya esters ki) se bante hain. Alkaline hydrolysis ke baad tezaab namak ki shakal mein hota hai aur use zyada taqatwar tezaab mila kar azad karna parta hai.

blocks.prompt: Tezaabi K2Cr2O7 (reflux par) se propan-1-ol ki oxidation ka mua'adla likhein.
blocks.explanation: CH3CH2CH2OH + 2[O] -> CH3CH2COOH + H2O (propanoic acid; pehle propanal banta hai).

blocks.prompt: (i) CH3CH2CN ki hydrolysis, (ii) ethylbenzene ki oxidation, (iii) ethyl ethanoate ki hydrolysis ke products aur mua'adlat batayein.
blocks.explanation: (i) CH3CH2CN + 2H2O + HCl -> CH3CH2COOH + NH4Cl (propanoic acid). (ii) C6H5CH2CH3 + 6[O] -> C6H5COOH + CO2 + 2H2O (benzoic acid; KMnO4, garmi). (iii) CH3COOCH2CH3 + H2O <=> CH3COOH + CH3CH2OH (ethanoic acid aur ethanol).

items: Primary alcohols ya aldehydes oxidise karein (reflux, tezaabi dichromate).
Nitriles ya esters hydrolyse karein (alkali, phir tezaab).
Methylbenzene ko benzoic acid mein oxidise karein.
